title: The Best Excuse
synopsis: A humorous story about four office workers who liked soccer too much.

fullText.simplified:
最好的借口

    四个年轻人中午下班后，一起去饭店吃饭。饭店里的电视上正在播放足球比赛。四个人都是球迷，边吃边看，结果忘了上班时间。等回过神来，发现早就过了上班时间了。
    四个人赶紧往公司跑。他们一到公司，就看见经理正等在办公室门口。四个人心里都在想迟到的理由。经理说：“说说吧，怎么都迟到了？”
    第一个人说：“我中午去了趟超市，坐车回来时正赶上路上有一起车祸，堵车了。”
    第二个人说：“我出门时，看见两个人在打架，我去劝架，结果耽误了时间。”
    第三个人说：“我家里有急事，回了一趟家。家离得远，所以晚了。”
    到第四个人了，经理等了半天，他也不开口。经理说：“怎么不说话呀？”第四个人委屈地说：“说什么呀，他们把我想说的理由都说了，我没什么可说的了。”
fullText.traditional:
最好的借口

    四個年輕人中午下班後，一起去飯店吃飯。飯店裡的電視上正在播放足球比賽。四個人都是球迷，邊吃邊看，結果忘了上班時間。等回過神來，發現早就過了上班時間了。
    四個人趕緊往公司跑。他們一到公司，就看見經理正等在辦公室門口。四個人心裡都在想遲到的理由。經理說：“說說吧，怎麼都遲到了？”
    第一個人說：“我中午去了趟超市，坐車回來時正趕上路上有一起車禍，堵車了。”
    第二個人說：“我出門時，看見兩個人在打架，我去勸架，結果耽誤了時間。”
    第三個人說：“我家裡有急事，回了一趟家。家離得遠，所以晚了。”
    到第四個人了，經理等了半天，他也不開口。經理說：“怎麼不說話呀？”第四個人委屈地說：“說什麼呀，他們把我想說的理由都說了，我沒什麼可說的了。”

raw.synopsis: A humorous story about four office workers who liked soccer too much.
sentence_translations: After getting off work at noon, four young people went out together to a restaurant to have lunch.
The TV inside the restaurant was in the middle of showing a game of soccer.
All four of them were soccer fans. They ate and watched the game, and as a result forgot it was time to go back to work.
When they came back to their senses, they realized the time they were supposed to go back to work had long passed.
The four people hurriedly rushed back to the office.
As soon as they arrived, they saw their manager waiting by the entrance of the office.
All four were trying to come up with a reason for being late. The manager said, “Tell me then, why are you all late?”
The first person said, “I went to the supermarket at noon.
After I started heading back, I encountered an accident on the road. I was stuck in traffic.”
The second person said, “When I was leaving, I noticed two people fighting.
I went to intervene in the fight, and as a result, I was held up.”
The third person said, “I had an urgent matter to take care of at home, so I went back home.
My home is far from here, so I was late.”
When it was the fourth person’s turn, the manager waited for a long time, but the person didn’t say anything.
The manager asked, “Why aren’t you saying anything?”
Feeling aggrieved, the fourth person said, “What can I say? They’ve already used all the reasons I wanted to use.
I don’t have anything to say.”
